controlled_change: Retained versus externally owned command buffers on eight fixed real Q4 expert records and inputs; five alternating isolated pairs.
correctness: Separate Metal validation and exact output hashes passed; caller-release and active-boundary lifetime tests pass.
decision_origin: authored interpretation; original report statuses retained
expected_effect: At least 20ms per token of plausible savings before a full request screen.
hypothesis: Removing duplicate Metal command resource references materially reduces expert submission latency.
limitations: Single M1 Pro, short 72-token initial request and 128-token retained append; no 2K/4K/7K or sustained-coding acceptance.
Production defaults remain unchanged. Paired intervals assume approximately independent log ratios; temporal host effects can violate this.
outcome: Primary one-expert ratio 0.99726, 95% interval 0.98526 to 1.00941. Optimistic scaling gives 0.13ms per token, below the experiment gate.
smallest_experiment: No repeat without a new reason to expect ownership bookkeeping to dominate; keep normal retained command references.
